text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad everyone's enjoying the hot spring. Apparently it was worth
all the effort we put into promoting it. And it's funny how confused
everyone was by that, uh... statue?
choice_data_list: And the air's so fresh here.
I wish we could relax too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな
温泉を喜んでくれてよかったよ。
がんばって宣伝したかいがあるってもんだよね。
みんなあの彫像？
　
に面食らってて
面白かったけど。

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
Right? She's got more comedic sense than Mahy... Huh?
It's not supposed to be funny? Then what the heck's it for?
Suddenly Producer seems a lot more scary.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だね。
まっひ～よりも笑いのセンスがあ……
え？
そういうのじゃないの？
　だとしたらなんなの？
急に
あのプロデューサーが怖くなってきたよ。

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
With both the hot spring and all this nature, the ranch could
become a really great tourist spot.But the better it becomes,
the busier I'm gonna be, and that's where things get complicated...
text_block_list.orig_text:
温泉と自然が揃ってて、
なんやかんや立派な観光地にできそうだよね。
立派になればなるほど
忙しくなりそうだから
それはそれで複雑だけど……

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
I know, right?! We have a hot spring right on our doorstep,
but we gotta keep working?! ...Well, Mahy's enjoying herself,
so I guess I can live with it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんとだよ！
　せっかく温泉があるのに働きづめなんだから！
……まぁ、
まっひ～が楽しそうだからいいんだけどね。
